name: Jenny Lewis
source:
Jenny Lewis never expected much from Bear Ridge Summer Camp. A shy and awkward recent high school graduate, she took the counselor job to escape the monotony of home, maybe make a few friends, and figure out what comes next. But fitting in has never been easy for Jenny, and camp life quickly proves to be more than she bargained for.

Thrown into a world of late-night campfires, whispered secrets, and an unease she can’t quite shake, Jenny must navigate friendships, first love, and something far more sinister lurking in the woods. As the summer unfolds, she'll have to decide—stay in her comfort zone or step up and face the unknown.

This was supposed to be the summer she found herself. Instead, she might just lose everything.
